name: How long does stucco repair take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does stucco repair take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stucco repair depends on the size and complexity of the damaged area. Small, superficial repairs might be completed within a day. Larger projects involving multiple sections, extensive damage, or custom texture matching can take several days to a week or more, including curing time between coats. We will provide a project timeline with your detailed estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; small repairs may take a day, while larger projects can span several days to a week, including curing.
